name: quark-torch-install
description: Install or verify the correct PyTorch build for a user's accelerator backend before Quark installation. Trigger for "install PyTorch", "pip install torch", "set up torch for ROCm", "set up torch for CUDA", "torch version mismatch", "CPU-only torch installed", torch.cuda.is_available() returns False, or any request to get the correct PyTorch build running.
